cameraNeeded: Camera access is needed to take a photo.
cameraOff: Camera access is off. Enable it in the Settings app.

fromLibrary.note: Pick a picture from the photo library instead of taking one.

attached.note: VoiceOver label of the full-screen photo.

hold.message: Lay the receipt flat and hold still
hold.note: Status over the camera while it waits to read a receipt.

failed.note: error is a short reason, possibly from the system.

lightTip.note: Added after the status, after " · ", once several tries have failed. Lowercase.

receipt.cameraNeeded: Camera access is needed to photograph the receipt.

read.zoomA11y: Photo. Pinch or double-tap to zoom.

text.note: Tab under the full-screen photo: the text read from it.

items.note: Tab under the full-screen photo: the receipt's lines.

reading.note: While the photo's text is being recognised.

findingItems.note: Text is read; the receipt's items are being worked out.

sorting.note: Items are read; a category is being guessed for each.

read.noText: No text found in this photo.

sortHint.message: Select items to file them under a category. Anything left unsorted stays with this entry.
sortHint.note: Above the receipt's items when they can be split.

selected.note: amount is the selected items' sum, formatted.

category.note: Button: choose the category for the selected items.

split.message: Split into {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}

fileAs.note: Every item went into one category other than the entry's: re-file the entry.

fill.note: Button over the photo's text panel; amount is the receipt total, formatted.

noteTotal.note: Last line of the receipt content written into the entry's note.

unsorted.message: Not sorted · stays with this entry
unsorted.note: Header over the receipt items given no category.

receipt.note: Camera mode: the document scanner that finds and shoots a receipt by itself. Short.

photo.note: Camera mode: an ordinary photo. Short.
